messages:
nina: Heads-up  we're coordinating Aurora onboarding: marketplace SKU, HW bundle (EdgeBox), SI packaging, and geo-restrictions. Need alignment on redistribution + quantized weights distribution.

mario: Quick Q  does the provider allow distributing quantized checkpoints (INT8) vs raw FP32? That affects storage/image size for EdgeBox.

zara: Provider's note: raw weights are CC-BY-like but they want any production redistribution to go through a commercial addendum. They've allowed quantized weights to be redistributed under the addendum.

nina: OK. So plan: list hosted/dedicated SKUs publicly; SI/EdgeBox bundles available under a paid redistribution addendum. We should capture that in marketplace metadata.

legal-bot: uploaded: /legal/aurora/provider_base_license.txt and /legal/aurora/initial_addendum_draft.docx (sha256: def456). Flag: base license permissive > hard to restrict downstream; addendum needs to sit outside base license as separate contract.

mario: For EdgeBox preinstall: need explicit consent to bake quantized checkpoints into vendor images shipped to SIs. If we only provide a download, easier. Vendor licensing might prohibit preinstalled weights.

kevin: Ops note  if EdgeBox images include weights we must ensure KMS integration and HSM-protected keys for any restricted builds. Also telemetry: we cannot get inference metrics if SIs rehost.

zara: Provider wants attribution in UI + link to model card, and a short embargo window: no press until 2 weeks after listing. They also asked for a single-point distributor for EU georestrictions.

nina: Geo blocking is doable at marketplace SKU level. For EU-only, we can provide an EU-domiciled Dedicated SKU and mark Private deploy as country-restricted. Need legal sign-off for export controls.

mario: Also confirm whether SIs can white-label the model in customer-facing apps. Provider prefers co-branding but might allow white-label for enterprise customers only under a separate clause.

legal-bot: Action item assigned: draft clause for "no rehosting without validated runtime" and a separate "SI redistribution license" that can permit rehosting if audits and telemetry obligations are met. ETA: Tue EOD.

kevin: From infra POV: two enforcement options: 1) require inference routing through Redwood API (easy telemetry/enforcement), 2) allow rehosting but require runtime attestation + periodic audit (harder but doable). We should list both in addendum.

zara: Provider is okay with option 2 if attestation is mandatory and we can suspend distribution on violations. They'll accept escrow for critical checkpoints but prefer not to publicize escrow terms.

mario: Pricing thought: base listing: hosted per-token; dedicated: reserved capacity pricing; SI bundle: flat license + per-deployment fee + support retainer. Need to model cannibalization risk vs revenue from redistribution.

nina: Good point. Olivia from product to build revenue scenarios, but for now we need a marketplace tag taxonomy: "open-model", "redistribution-allowed", "SI-bundle-available", "geo-restricted".

legal-bot: I've placed the draft addendum in drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/aurora/addendum_v0.1.docx. Includes: audit right, telemetry SLA, revocation clause, and escrow option.

kevin: If we permit rehosting under addendum, add a "validated runtime" checklist: kernel versions, quantization steps, KV cache behavior, and test prompts to verify outputs. Ops can automate tests during onboarding.

zara: Also add a short clause about model updates: provider will push minor patch weights but any major architecture change requires new agreement.

mario: Embargo: provider asks for 14 days after marketplace publish. We need to align PR & partner comms with marketing. I'll sync with marketing.

nina: Actions recap: legal to finalise addendum draft (Tue EOD); ops to define validated runtime checklist (kevin); product to assemble SKU & tags (olivia will take it); marketing to coordinate embargo/announcement cadence (mario). Sync Thu 9am PT to confirm.

zara: I'll message the provider with the proposed two-track approach (hosted listing + addendum for SI rehosting + options for EdgeBox preinstall).

mario: Thanks  drop any quick blockers here. If EdgeBox says no preinstall, we'll default to signed download + install script.

nina: Thanks team. Documenting owners in the Aurora drive and will circulate meeting invite for Thu 9am PT. :rocket:
